Sandbox_MadScientist_SpawnChancePercent_: Percent of zombies that become the Mad Scientist (0-100, decimals allowed). E.g. 0.5 = 0.5%, 0.01 is roughly 1 in 10,000. Raising this converts more existing zombies; lowering it does not un-convert ones already turned.
Sandbox_MadScientist_SprinterPercentage_: Percent chance (0-100) that each Mad Scientist zombie is a sprinter, mirroring the vanilla Sprinter Percentage setting. 100 = always a sprinter, 0 = never. Changing this applies to already-spawned Mad Scientists.
Sandbox_MadScientist_HealthMultiplier_to: Health multiplier for the Mad Scientist zombie (e.g. 3.0 = 3x tougher to kill).
Sandbox_MadScientist_DamageMultiplier_to: Damage multiplier when the Mad Scientist attacks a player character.
Sandbox_MadScientist_CureGuaranteed_tool: Guarantees that the Mad Scientist carries the Knox Virus Cure in inventory.
Sandbox_MadScientist_WeightAgoraphobic_t: Relative chance weight (0 = never) that using the cure inflicts the Agoraphobic trait. Higher = more likely relative to other traits.
